blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's topic is Bills and Payments. These are short, useful words you can use with the finance team.

You will learn five words: a bill, a payment, a due date, a receipt, and a deadline. The bill always has to match the records. There is a new payment to review this week.

Go slowly — one step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is today's topic?
items.why: "Today's topic is Bills and Payments."

items.q: How many words will you learn?
items.why: "You will learn five words."

items.q: What must the bill do?
items.why: "The bill always has to match the records."

items.q: The text says "one step at a time." This suggests that…
options: you should learn slowly and calmly
you need help from the team
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly — one step at a time" mostra que a ideia é ir com calma.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: English can be learned, step by step
items.why: Inferência: "English comes in CAN's… You can do it!" mostra um tom positivo e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falar com um novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, and welcome to the team! My name is Sophie. I work here at Czarnikow, in accounting. Today I want to help you with bills and payments.

Let's start small. A bill is money we have to pay. A payment is when we pay it. Easy, right? Say it with me: bill, payment. Good!

Every bill has a due date. That is the day we must pay. And after we pay, we get a receipt. The receipt is your proof. Keep it safe, please.

We also have a deadline for our reports. The deadline is on Friday. Please put your work on my desk before then.

Don't worry. We go one step at a time. You can ask me anything. I am here to help. You are doing very well already!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "My name is Sophie. I work here at Czarnikow, in accounting."

items.q: What is a bill?
items.why: "A bill is money we have to pay."

items.q: When is the deadline for the reports?
items.why: "The deadline is on Friday."

items.q: Why does Sophie say "Keep it safe" about the receipt?
options: Because the bank wants it back
Because it is your proof of payment
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "The receipt is your proof" — por isso deve ser guardado.

items.q: How would you describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: "Don't worry… You are doing very well already!" mostra um tom gentil e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please pay this bill today." A bill is…
options: a paper that shows money to pay
items.why: Bill = conta / boleto: o papel que mostra o valor a pagar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We sent the ___ to the bank yesterday."
items.why: Payment = pagamento: o dinheiro que enviamos ao banco.

items.q: "The bill is due on Monday." Due means…
items.why: Due = vencimento: o dia em que devemos pagar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Keep the ___ — it is your proof that you paid."
items.why: Receipt = recibo: a prova de que o pagamento foi feito.

items.q: "The report has a deadline on Friday." A deadline is…
items.why: Deadline = prazo: o último dia para terminar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com contas e pagamentos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill in the form." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher: escrever as informações no formulário.

items.q: "Can you check on this payment?" To check on means to…
options: look at it to see it is right
items.why: Check on = verificar, dar uma olhada para ver se está certo.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the bill." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please hand in the report by Friday." To hand in means to…
options: give it to the person in charge
items.why: Hand in = entregar o trabalho a quem é responsável.

items.q: "Don't forget to follow up on the late payment." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, checar de novo depois.
